questions.question_text: Explain the difference between Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
questions.answer_key: Machine Learning is a subset of Artificial Intelligence that involves training algorithms to make predictions or decisions based on data. Deep Learning is a subset of Machine Learning that involves the use of neural networks with multiple layers to analyze data.

questions.question_text: Describe the Perceptron model and its limitations.
questions.answer_key: The Perceptron model is a type of neural network that uses a single layer of perceptrons to make predictions. Its limitations include the inability to learn non-linear relationships and the need for a large number of perceptrons to achieve good performance.

questions.question_text: Analyze the advantages and disadvantages of using a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) for deep learning tasks.
questions.answer_key: Advantages of MLP include its ability to learn complex relationships and its flexibility in terms of the number of layers and neurons. Disadvantages include the risk of overfitting and the need for careful tuning of hyperparameters.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of a biological neuron and how it relates to an artificial neuron.
questions.answer_key: A biological neuron is a cell in the brain that processes and transmits information. An artificial neuron is a mathematical model that mimics the behavior of a biological neuron, using inputs, weights, and activation functions to make predictions.

questions.question_text: Describe the role of activation functions in a neural network.
questions.answer_key: Activation functions introduce non-linearity into a neural network, allowing it to learn complex relationships between inputs and outputs.
